content.text: All indemnity elements are present at the preferred level; no redline needed.

input.quote: 20.1 Vendor shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Customer, its Affiliates, and their directors, officers, employees, and agents from each third-party claim and resulting damages, settlements, judgments, penalties, costs, and reasonable attorneys' fees arising from an allegation that the Services or Deliverables infringe or misappropriate an intellectual property right.
input.rationale: Section 20 meets the preferred position in full. 20.1 gives an express Vendor duty to defend, indemnify and hold harmless Customer and its Affiliates against third-party claims that the Services or Deliverables infringe or misappropriate IP. 20.2 extends the Vendor indemnity to Vendor's breach of Applicable Law, unauthorized access to or disclosure of Customer Data caused by Vendor, and Vendor's gross negligence, wilful misconduct and fraud. 20.4 supplies the standard procedure (prompt notice, control of the defence, reasonable cooperation at the indemnifying Party's expense, plus settlement consent protections). 20.3 keeps Customer's reverse indemnity narrow — unmodified Customer-supplied material used strictly as authorized and Customer's own violation of Applicable Law, with carve-outs for Vendor Technology, modification, combination or instructions. Beyond the checklist, 20.5 adds procure/modify/replace/refund remedies and 21.3 places indemnification obligations, gross negligence, wilful misconduct and IP infringement outside the liability cap, so no super-cap fallback is needed. No redline proposed.
